title: A week of every bus, train and ferry in San Diego
description:
A week of every bus, train and ferry in San Diego, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the San Diego city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Rapid, Trolley and Ferry.

Busiest moment: 281 vehicles, Thursday at 3:43 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night.
